messages:
Mira Patel: Heads-up: need a tight sync for marketplace + press cadence for upcoming H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Any absolute embargo/blackout windows Apr-May?

Vendor PM - Nvidia: Tentative firmware freeze H100/H200 on 2026-04-21 (+/-5d). Possible press week late-April, will confirm.

Vendor PM - AMD: MI300 driver parity fix ETA 2026-05-02; may slip by a week. No press embargo on our side.

Kelvin Cho: Ops: freeze blocks image rebuilds that touch drivers. B200 supply ok in June.

Alex Kim: Marketplace requires final image + signed EULA + compat matrix 10 business days before publish. If freeze holds, need artifacts by ~2026-04-07 for late-April. Mid-May window needs final by 2026-05-01.

Sofia Alvarez: SI dry-run proposed: Gaudi/H100 2026-04-12; MI300 2026-05-05. Checklist: image pull, driver-kernel compatibility, KV-cache warmup, sample inference, tracing.

Integrator - CoreSys: We'll join dry-runs; need secure image access and kernel module docs.

Ryan O'Neal: Legal asks for OEM attribution line and EULA drafts by 2026-04-09 for primary; compressed fallback by 2026-04-22.

Mira Patel: Plan: primary consolidated announce 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-17 (waits for MI300); fallback small wave late-April if vendors confirm.

Action items: Mira confirm vendor freezes/press windows by 2026-04-02; Kelvin file provisioning tickets for dry-run lab by 2026-03-28; Alex start SKU templates by 2026-03-30; Sofia invite integrators by 2026-03-29; Ryan collect vendor legal contacts by 2026-03-29.

Alex Kim: Will block marketplace QA and marketing hold dates.

Vendor PM - Nvidia: Will confirm press + freeze certainty by 2026-03-31.

Mira Patel: Thanks everyone, ping here for any updates.
